title: Zamonlar: nozik farqlar va kontekst
goal_uz: Dars oxirida perfect continuous va past perfect ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, hikoyada va ko‘chirma gapda zamonlarni aniq ishlatasiz hamda zamon xatolarini topib, sababini tushuntirib to‘g‘rilay olasiz.

scenes.title: Zamonlar: nozik farqlar
scenes.say: Hello again. Last time we looked at the three pillars of B2. Today we sharpen one of them: accuracy with tenses.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda B2 ning uch ustunini, ya’ni ravonlik, aniqlik va boylikni ko‘rib chiqdik. Bugun aniqlikni mustahkamlaymiz: zamonlarning nozik farqlarini o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida perfect continuous va past perfect ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, hikoya va gapni ko‘chirishda zamonlarni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz hamda o‘z xatolaringizni tushuntirib tuzata olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Oldingi darsda B2 ning uch ustunini ko‘rdik. Bugun aniqlikni, ya’ni zamonlarning nozik farqlarini mustahkamlaymiz.

scenes.title: Zamon va aspekt
board: Aspect = HOW we see the action
scenes.say: Tense tells us when. Aspect tells us how we see the action: as a fact, as in progress, or as connected to another moment.
scenes.say_native: Avval bitta tushunchani aniqlaymiz. Zamon bu vaqt: o‘tgan yoki hozirgi. Aspekt esa harakatga qanday qaraganimiz: oddiy fakt sifatida, davom etayotgan jarayon sifatida yoki boshqa vaqt bilan bog‘liq sifatida. Shuning uchun bir xil o‘tgan vaqtda ham “I worked”, “I was working”, “I had worked” deymiz, va ularning ma’nosi turlicha. B2 da aynan shu tanlov sizdan talab qilinadi.
scenes.say_uz: Zamon qachonligini bildiradi. Aspekt harakatga qanday qarashimizni bildiradi: fakt, jarayon yoki boshqa vaqt bilan bog‘liqlik sifatida.

scenes.title: Present perfect continuous
board: How long have you been waiting?

examples.t: I've been waiting for an hour.
She's been working too hard lately.
examples.uz: U oxirgi paytlarda juda ko‘p ishlayapti.

examples.t: Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?

scenes.say: I've been waiting for an hour. She's been working too hard lately. You look tired. Have you been crying?
scenes.say_native: Present perfect continuous “have been” va fe’lning “-ing” shaklidan iborat. U faoliyatning o‘zini va davomiyligini ko‘rsatadi: harakat o‘tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etmoqda yoki hozirgina tugagan, izi esa ko‘rinib turibdi. O‘zbekchada “bir soatdan beri kutyapman” desak, inglizchada aynan shu zamon kerak. Hozirgi zamonning o‘zi, ya’ni “I wait for an hour” esa xato.
scenes.say_uz: Bir soatdan beri kutyapman. U oxirgi paytlarda juda ko‘p ishlayapti. Charchagan ko‘rinasiz. Yig‘lagandingizmi?

scenes.title: Simple va continuous: natija yoki jarayon
board: Continuous: activity, how long, still going
I've read the book. / I've been reading the book.

examples.t: I've read three chapters.
I've been reading all afternoon.

scenes.say: I've read three chapters: the result. I've been reading all afternoon: the activity.
scenes.say_native: Endi farq. Present perfect simple natijani va miqdorni ko‘rsatadi: “I’ve read three chapters”, ya’ni uch bob tugadi. Continuous esa jarayonni va davomiylikni: “I’ve been reading all afternoon”, ya’ni tushdan beri o‘qiyapman, tugagan-tugamagani muhim emas. Savol ham shunga qarab beriladi: “How many chapters have you read?” va “How long have you been reading?” Bu ikki savolni yodlab oling.
scenes.say_uz: Uch bobni o‘qib bo‘ldim: natija. Tushdan beri o‘qiyapman: jarayon.

scenes.title: Miqdor bilan continuous bo‘lmaydi
board: ✓ I've been writing emails all morning.
scenes.say: When we count, we use the simple form. I've written five emails. I've been writing emails all morning.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: miqdor aytilganda continuous ishlatish. Agar son bo‘lsa, ya’ni “five emails”, natija muhim, shuning uchun simple: “I’ve written five emails”. Davomiylikni aytsak, continuous: “all morning”. Yana bir xato: “know”, “like”, “want” kabi holat fe’llarini continuous qilish. “I’ve been knowing her for years” deyilmaydi, to‘g‘risi “I’ve known her for years”.
scenes.say_uz: Son aytilsa, simple ishlatamiz: besh xat yozdim. Davomiylikda continuous: ertalabdan beri xat yozyapman.

scenes.title: Simple yoki continuous
board: 1) I ___ (read) this book for two hours.
scenes.say: Choose the correct form. Say each full sentence aloud.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida davomiylik, ikkinchisida miqdor, uchinchisida holat fe’li bor. Har bir gapni to‘liq ayting. Avval vaqt so‘zini toping: for, so far. Keyin o‘zingizdan so‘rang, bu yerda jarayon muhimmi yoki natija? Uchinchi gapda fe’lning turiga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Har bir gapni to‘liq ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I've been reading this book for two hours.
3) How long have you known Tom?
scenes.say: I've been reading for two hours. I've read fifty pages so far. How long have you known Tom?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisi “I’ve been reading”, chunki “for two hours” davomiylikni bildiradi. Ikkinchisi “I’ve read”, chunki “fifty pages” aniq son. Uchinchisi “How long have you known Tom?”, chunki “know” holat fe’li va continuous qilinmaydi. Agar uchalasini ham to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bu zamon sizda mustahkam.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki soatdan beri o‘qiyapman. Hozircha ellik bet o‘qidim. Tomni qancha vaqtdan beri bilasiz?

scenes.title: Past perfect
board: The earlier of two past events
By the time we arrived, the film had started.

examples.t: When I got to the station, the train had left.
examples.uz: Bekatga yetib borganimda poyezd ketib bo‘lgan edi.

examples.t: She was upset because she had lost her phone.
examples.uz: U telefonini yo‘qotgani uchun xafa edi.

scenes.say: When I got to the station, the train had left. She was upset because she had lost her phone.
scenes.say_native: Past perfect — “had” va fe’lning uchinchi shakli. U o‘tmishdagi ikki voqeadan oldin sodir bo‘lganini ko‘rsatadi. Bekatga yetib borish keyin, poyezdning ketishi undan oldin, shuning uchun ketishga “had left”. O‘zbekchada “-gan edi” shakli deyarli shu vazifani bajaradi: “poyezd ketgan edi”. Shuning uchun bu zamon siz uchun unchalik begona emas, faqat uni o‘z o‘rnida ishlatishni o‘rganish kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Bekatga yetganimda poyezd ketib bo‘lgan edi. U telefonini yo‘qotgani uchun xafa edi.

scenes.title: Ketma-ketlik yoki ma’no farqi
board: When I arrived, she left. (1 arrived, 2 left)
When I arrived, she had left. (1 left, 2 arrived)

examples.t: When I arrived, she left.
When I arrived, she had left.
examples.uz: Men kelganimda u allaqachon ketgan edi.

scenes.say: When I arrived, she left: first I arrived. When I arrived, she had left: she was already gone.
scenes.say_native: Bitta so‘z o‘zgarishi butun ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. “When I arrived, she left” — avval men keldim, keyin u ketdi. “When I arrived, she had left” — men kelganimda u allaqachon ketgan edi, men uni topa olmadim. Shuning uchun voqealar tartibi muhim bo‘lsa, past perfect ishlating. Tartib aniq bo‘lsa, masalan “after” yoki “before” bilan, ko‘pincha past simple ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men kelganimda u ketdi: avval kelganman. Men kelganimda u ketib bo‘lgan edi: u allaqachon ketgan.

scenes.title: Past perfect tushirib qoldirish
board: ✗ When I called, he already left.
✓ When I called, he had already left.
✗ I had been to Paris last year.
✓ I went to Paris last year.
scenes.say: Do not forget had when the action came first. But do not use past perfect when you simply say what happened last year.
scenes.say_native: Ikki yo‘nalishdagi xato. Birinchisi: oldin bo‘lgan voqeaga “had” qo‘ymaslik. “When I called, he already left” emas, “he had already left”. Ikkinchisi teskari: past perfect ni ortiqcha ishlatish. Agar boshqa o‘tmish voqea bilan taqqoslamasangiz, “I went to Paris last year” deysiz, “had been” emas. Past perfect doim ikkinchi, keyingi o‘tgan voqeaga ishora qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Oldin bo‘lgan voqeaga had qo‘ying. Lekin taqqoslamasdan oddiy o‘tgan voqeani aytganda past simple ishlating.

scenes.title: Past perfect continuous

examples.t: She was exhausted. She had been working since six.
examples.uz: U juda charchagan edi. U oltidan beri ishlayotgan edi.

examples.t: The ground was wet. It had been raining.
examples.uz: Yer ho‘l edi. Yomg‘ir yog‘ib turgan edi.

scenes.say: She was exhausted. She had been working since six. The ground was wet because it had been raining.
scenes.say_native: Past perfect continuous — “had been” va “-ing”. U o‘tmishdagi biror payt oldidan davom etgan faoliyatni ko‘rsatadi va ko‘pincha o‘sha paytdagi holatning sababini tushuntiradi. Yer ho‘l edi, chunki yomg‘ir yog‘ib turgan edi. U charchagan edi, chunki oltidan beri ishlagan. Present perfect continuous ning o‘tmishdagi nusxasi desak bo‘ladi: hozirdan emas, o‘tmishdagi nuqtadan orqaga qaraymiz.
scenes.say_uz: U juda charchagan edi: oltidan beri ishlagan. Yer ho‘l edi, chunki yomg‘ir yog‘gan edi.

scenes.title: Past perfect tanlang
board: 2) He was out of breath. He ___ (run).
3) I ___ (not / see) her before that day.
scenes.say: Complete with past perfect, simple or continuous. Say the full sentences.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida voqea bitta, ikkinchisida faoliyat va sabab, uchinchisida inkor shakl. Qaysi biri simple, qaysi biri continuous bo‘lishini o‘ylang. Har gapda ikki voqea bor. Qaysi biri oldin sodir bo‘lganini aniqlang, aynan o‘sha voqeaga had ishlatiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Past perfect shaklini tanlang va to‘liq gaplarni ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) I hadn't seen her before that day.
scenes.say: The concert had started. He had been running. I hadn't seen her before that day.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi gap: “the concert had started”, ya’ni konsert biz kelishimizdan oldin boshlangan. Ikkinchi gap: nafasi qaytmayotgan edi, sababi yugurganida, shuning uchun “had been running”. Uchinchi gap: “hadn’t seen”, inkor shakl, “had not” ning qisqa shakli. Hammasi mantiq bilan tanlanadi: nima oldin bo‘lgan va qanday bo‘lgan.
scenes.say_uz: Biz kelganimizda konsert boshlangan edi. U yugurgan edi. Men uni o‘sha kungacha ko‘rmagan edim.

scenes.title: Past simple va present perfect
board: Finished time: yesterday, last week, in 2019, ago → past simple
Time not finished or no time: today, this week, ever, yet, just → present perfect

examples.t: I saw him yesterday.
I've seen him today.
examples.uz: Men uni bugun ko‘rdim (bugun hali tugamagan).

scenes.say: I saw him yesterday. I've seen him today. Yesterday is finished, but today is still going.
scenes.say_native: Bu ikki zamonni aralashtirish B2 dagi eng keng tarqalgan muammolardan biri. Qoida: aniq tugagan vaqt bor, ya’ni yesterday, last week, in 2019, three days ago bo‘lsa, past simple. Vaqt hali davom etayotgan bo‘lsa, ya’ni today, this week, yoki aniq vaqt aytilmasa, present perfect. O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham “ko‘rdim” bo‘lib ketadi, shuning uchun bizda bu xato tez-tez uchraydi.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha tugagan, shuning uchun past simple. Bugun hali davom etmoqda, shuning uchun present perfect.

scenes.title: Tugagan vaqt bilan present perfect
scenes.say: We never use present perfect with a finished time or with the question When. We say: I saw him yesterday. When did you arrive?
scenes.say_native: Aniq o‘tgan vaqt bilan present perfect ishlatilmaydi. “I have seen him yesterday” noto‘g‘ri. Shuningdek, “When” so‘rog‘i ham aniq vaqtni so‘raydi, shuning uchun “When have you arrived?” deb bo‘lmaydi, to‘g‘risi “When did you arrive?”. Shu ikki xatoni yodlab olsangiz, ko‘pchilik adashishlardan qutulasiz. Amerika ingliz tilida “Did you eat yet?” kabi gaplar ham uchraydi, lekin Britaniya me’yorida present perfect ishlatiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Tugagan vaqt va When bilan present perfect ishlatmaymiz: Kecha uni ko‘rdim. Qachon keldingiz?

scenes.title: Zamonni tanlang
board: 1) I ___ (lose) my keys this morning, so I'm late.
scenes.say: Choose present perfect or past simple. Say the full sentence.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap. Birinchisida “this morning”, ikkinchisida “in 2018”, uchinchisida “ever”. Har birining vaqt ko‘rsatkichiga qarab zamonni tanlang va to‘liq ayting. Vaqt so‘zi har bir gapni hal qiladi. Tugagan vaqt bo‘lsa past simple, hali tugamagan yoki noma’lum vaqt bo‘lsa present perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Present perfect yoki past simple ni tanlang. To‘liq gapni ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I've lost my keys this morning.
scenes.say: I've lost my keys this morning. We moved here in 2018. Have you ever tried sushi?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi gap: “this morning” hali tugamagan vaqt va natija hozirgi, shuning uchun present perfect: “I’ve lost”. Ikkinchi gap: “in 2018” aniq o‘tgan vaqt, shuning uchun “moved”. Uchinchi gap: “ever” bilan hayotdagi tajriba so‘raladi, shuning uchun “Have you ever tried”. Agar javobingiz shunday bo‘lsa, ofarin!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ertalab kalitlarimni yo‘qotdim. Biz bu yerga 2018 yilda ko‘chib kelganmiz. Siz hech suši tatib ko‘rganmisiz?

scenes.title: Past continuous va past simple
board: Past simple: main events, short action
I was cooking when she called.

examples.t: I was cooking when she called.
examples.uz: U qo‘ng‘iroq qilganda men ovqat tayyorlayotgan edim.

examples.t: While we were walking, it started to rain.
examples.uz: Biz yurib ketayotganimizda yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

scenes.say: I was cooking when she called. While we were walking, it started to rain.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya qilganda fonni past continuous bilan, asosiy voqealarni past simple bilan beramiz. “I was cooking” — fon, jarayon. “She called” — qisqa, uzilish. Shuning uchun “when she called” da past simple. “While” esa odatda jarayon bilan keladi. O‘zbekchada ikkalasi ham “-ayotgan edi” va “-di” bilan ifodalanadi, shuning uchun mantiq o‘xshash, faqat inglizchada tanlov majburiy.
scenes.say_uz: U qo‘ng‘iroq qilganda men ovqat tayyorlayotgan edim. Yurib ketayotganimizda yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tergov
board: Officer: Where were you at eight?
Mark: I was working late. I had finished the report by seven.
Officer: And what did you do after that?
scenes.say: Officer: Where were you at eight last night? Mark: I was working late. I had finished the report by seven, so I was just checking emails. Officer: And what did you do after that? Mark: I locked the office and went home.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Politsiyachi Markdan kecha soat sakkizda qayerda bo‘lganini so‘raydi. Mark zamonlarni juda aniq ishlatadi: jarayon, oldingi tugagan ish va keyingi voqealar. Savollarga e’tibor bering: soat sakkizda u nima qilayotgan edi va yetti kunigacha nimani tugatgan edi?
scenes.say_uz: Politsiyachi: Kecha soat sakkizda qayerda eding? Mark: Kech ishlayotgan edim. Hisobotni yettigacha tugatgan edim, shuning uchun xatlarni tekshirayotgan edim. Keyin ofisni qulflab uyga ketdim.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1) What was Mark doing at eight?
2) What had he finished by seven?
scenes.say: What was Mark doing at eight? What had he finished by seven? What did he do last?
scenes.say_native: Uch savolga javob bering. Birinchisi jarayon haqida, ikkinchisi oldin tugatgan ish haqida, uchinchisi eng oxirgi voqea haqida. Javobda to‘g‘ri zamon ishlating. Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan aytishni unutmang. Bu ham nutq mashqi: zamon to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin, gap esa tabiiy eshitilsin.
scenes.say_uz: Mark soat sakkizda nima qilayotgan edi? Yettigacha nimani tugatgan edi? Eng oxirida nima qildi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 3) He locked the office and went home.
scenes.say: He was checking emails. He had finished the report. He locked the office and went home.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: soat sakkizda u xatlarni tekshirayotgan edi, “was checking” — jarayon. Yettigacha hisobotni tugatgan edi, “had finished” — oldingi voqea. Oxirida ofisni qulflab, uyga ketdi, “locked” va “went” — ketma-ket past simple. Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta qisqa dialogda uch xil zamon har biri o‘z vazifasida kelyapti.
scenes.say_uz: U xatlarni tekshirayotgan edi. U hisobotni tugatgan edi. U ofisni qulflab, uyga ketdi.

scenes.title: Hikoyada zamonlar

examples.t: So I'm walking down the street and this man stops me.
examples.uz: Men ko‘chada ketayotsam, bir odam meni to‘xtatdi.

scenes.say: In a story, use past simple for events, past continuous for the scene, and past perfect for what happened before. In casual anecdotes we can use the present for effect.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya uch qatlamdan iborat. Asosiy voqealar past simple da, sahna va fon past continuous da, undan oldingi voqealar past perfect da. Og‘zaki hikoyalarda, ayniqsa kulgili voqea aytganda, ba’zan hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi: “So I’m walking down the street and this man stops me”. Bu hikoyani jonli qiladi, lekin yozma va rasmiy nutqda ishlatmang.
scenes.say_uz: Voqealar past simple da, fon past continuous da, oldingi voqealar past perfect da. Og‘zaki hikoyada ta’sir uchun hozirgi zamon ham ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy hikoya
board: It was raining when I left home.
I had forgotten my umbrella, so I got soaked.
By the time I reached work, I was freezing.
scenes.say: It was raining when I left home. I had forgotten my umbrella, so I got completely soaked. By the time I reached work, I was freezing.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa hikoyani tahlil qilamiz. “It was raining” — fon. “I left” — voqea. “I had forgotten” — oldin bo‘lgan sabab. “I got soaked” — oqibat. “By the time I reached work” — vaqt ko‘rsatkichi. Bu yerda uchala qatlam bor va ular o‘rtasidagi bog‘lanish ravon. Aynan shunday hikoya B2 darajasida kutiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Uydan chiqqanimda yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi. Soyabonimni unutgan edim, shuning uchun butunlay ho‘l bo‘ldim. Ishga yetganimda muzlab qolgan edim.

scenes.title: Hikoyani to‘ldiring
board: Last week I ___ (walk) home when I ___ (realise) that I ___ (leave) my wallet at the cafe.
scenes.say: Complete the story with the right tenses. Say the full sentences.
scenes.say_native: Hikoyani to‘ldiring. Har bir bo‘shliq uchun avval nima oldin, nima keyin bo‘lganini, qaysi biri fon ekanini o‘ylang. Natijani to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Har bir bo‘shliqdan oldin o‘ylang: bu fonmi, asosiy voqeami yoki oldin bo‘lgan sababmi? Shunga qarab zamonni tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyani to‘g‘ri zamonlar bilan to‘ldiring. To‘liq gaplarni ayting.

scenes.title: Hikoya javobi
scenes.say: Last week I was walking home when I realised that I had left my wallet at the cafe. I ran back, but it had already closed.
scenes.say_native: Javob: “I was walking home” — jarayon. “I realised” — qisqa voqea. “I had left my wallet” — oldin bo‘lgan. Ikkinchi gapda “I ran back” va “it had already closed”, kafe men yetib borishimdan oldin yopilgan edi. Kafe haqida “it closed” desak ham bo‘lardi, lekin “had already closed” aynan oldin yopilganini aniq ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan hafta uyga ketayotib, hamyonimni kafeda qoldirganimni angladim. Orqaga yugurdim, lekin u allaqachon yopilgan edi.

scenes.title: Gapni ko‘chirish: zamon siljishi

examples.t: 'I am tired,' she said. → She said she was tired.
'I've finished,' he said. → He said he had finished.

scenes.say: She said she was tired. He said he had finished. In reported speech, the verb often moves one step back in time.
scenes.say_native: Birovning gapini ko‘chirganda fe’l odatda bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi. Present — past ga: “am” — “was”. Present perfect — past perfect ga: “I’ve finished” — “he had finished”. “Will” — “would”. Past simple ham ko‘pincha past perfect bo‘ladi. Lekin gap hali ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siljitmasa ham bo‘ladi: “She said she lives in Leeds”. Bu qoida o‘zbekchada yo‘q, chunki o‘zbek tilida ko‘chirma gapda zamon o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: U charchaganini aytdi. U tugatganini aytdi. Ko‘chirma gapda fe’l odatda bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi.

scenes.title: Say va tell
board: ✗ He told that he was busy.
✓ He said that he was busy.
✓ He told me that he was busy.
scenes.say: Say has no person after it. Tell needs a person. He said he was busy. He told me he was busy.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘chirma gapdagi eng keng tarqalgan ikki xato. Birinchisi: “say” dan keyin shaxs kelmaydi, “say me” emas. “Tell” dan keyin esa shaxs shart: “he told me”. Ikkinchisi: zamonni siljitmaslik, “She said she has finished” emas, “she had finished”. Agar ma’no hali o‘zgarmagan bo‘lsa, siljitmasa ham bo‘ladi, lekin yozma ishlarda siljitish xavfsizroq yo‘l.
scenes.say_uz: Say dan keyin shaxs kelmaydi, tell dan keyin shaxs kerak. U band ekanini aytdi. U menga band ekanini aytdi.

scenes.title: Gapni ko‘chiring
scenes.say: Report each sentence. Begin with: She said, They said, He told me.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni ko‘chirma gapga aylantiring. Birinchisi “She said”, ikkinchisi “They said”, uchinchisi “He told me” bilan boshlanadi. Zamonni bir pog‘ona orqaga suring va to‘liq ayting. Esda tuting: zamonni bir pog‘ona orqaga surasiz, olmoshlar ham o‘zgaradi. Sekin boshlang, so‘ng tezlashtiring.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni ko‘chirma gapga aylantiring.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirma javoblari
board: 1) She said she was going to leave.
2) They said they had booked a table.
3) He told me he would call me.
scenes.say: She said she was going to leave. They said they had booked a table. He told me he would call me.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “am going to” — “was going to”. “Have booked” — “had booked”. “Will call” — “would call”. Olmoshlar ham o‘zgardi: “I” — “she”, “we” — “they”, “you” — “me”. Bu ham nozik joy: zamon bilan birga kim haqida gapirilayotganini ham kuzating. Birinchi shaxs ikkinchi yoki uchinchi shaxsga aylanadi.
scenes.say_uz: U ketmoqchi ekanini aytdi. Ular stol band qilganini aytdi. U menga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishini aytdi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: yig‘ilish haqida
board: Lena: Did you speak to Karim?
Tom: Yes. He said he had been waiting for the manager since nine.
Lena: Did he say when the meeting would start?
scenes.say: Lena: Did you speak to Karim? Tom: Yes. He said he had been waiting for the manager since nine, but she hadn't arrived. Lena: Did he say when the meeting would start? Tom: He said it would start as soon as she got there.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir dialog. Lena Tomdan Karim bilan gaplashgan-gaplashmaganini so‘raydi. Tom Karimning so‘zlarini ko‘chirma gap bilan aytib beradi. Tinglang: Karim qachondan beri kutyapti va yig‘ilish qachon boshlanadi? Bu safar uchta ishtirokchi haqida gap boradi, shuning uchun kim kimning so‘zini aytayotganiga e’tibor bering. Birinchi marta umumiy ma’noga quloq soling.
scenes.say_uz: Lena: Karim bilan gaplashdingmi? Tom: Ha. U soat to‘qqizdan beri menejerni kutayotganini, lekin u kelmaganini aytdi. Lena: Yig‘ilish qachon boshlanishini aytdimi? Tom: Menejer yetib kelishi bilan boshlanishini aytdi.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1) How long had Karim been waiting?
scenes.say: How long had Karim been waiting? When would the meeting start?
scenes.say_native: Ikki savolga javob bering. Karim qachondan beri kutgan edi? Yig‘ilish qachon boshlanishi aytilgan? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan, to‘g‘ri zamonda ayting. Javobni to‘liq gap qilib, ko‘chirma gap zamoni bilan ayting. Agar eslolmasangiz, dialogni xotirangizda qayta eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Karim qachondan beri kutayotgan edi? Yig‘ilish qachon boshlanadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) As soon as the manager got there.
scenes.say: He had been waiting since nine. The meeting would start as soon as the manager got there.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Karim soat to‘qqizdan beri kutayotgan edi, “had been waiting since nine”. Yig‘ilish menejer yetib kelishi bilan boshlanadi, “would start as soon as she got there”. Diqqat qiling: “as soon as” dan keyin ham o‘tgan zamon, ya’ni “got”, chunki biz ko‘chirma gapdamiz. Ko‘chirma gapdagi bunday zamon moslashuvi B2 ning kuchli belgisidir.
scenes.say_uz: U to‘qqizdan beri kutayotgan edi. Yig‘ilish menejer yetib kelishi bilan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Xato tahlili: to‘rt qadam
board: 1) Find the time (finished? connected to now?)
4) Check markers: for, since, ago, yet, already
scenes.say: To analyse a tense error, ask four questions: what is the time, which tense, result or activity, and which time markers are there?
scenes.say_native: Xatoni tahlil qilishning to‘rt qadamli yo‘li bor. Birinchi: vaqt tugaganmi yoki hozirga bog‘liqmi? Ikkinchi: shunga qarab past yoki perfect tanlang. Uchinchi: natija muhimmi yoki jarayon? Shunga qarab simple yoki continuous. To‘rtinchi: vaqt so‘zlarini tekshiring. “Ago” faqat past simple bilan, “for” va “since” perfect bilan keladi. Uy vazifasida aynan shu usuldan foydalanasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xatoni tahlil qilish uchun to‘rt savol bering: vaqt qanday, qaysi zamon, natijami yoki jarayon, va vaqt ko‘rsatkichi qanday.

scenes.title: Vaqt ko‘rsatkichlari
board: ago, last, yesterday, in 2020 → past simple
for, since, so far, recently → present perfect
by the time, before, already (earlier) → past perfect

examples.t: I started three years ago.
I've been learning for three years.

scenes.say: I started three years ago. I've been learning for three years. Ago goes with past simple. For and since go with the perfect.
scenes.say_native: Mana qisqa jadval. “Ago”, “last”, “yesterday”, “in 2020” — past simple. “For”, “since”, “so far”, “recently” — present perfect. “By the time”, “before”, “already” o‘tmishdagi biror payt bilan — past perfect. “Three years ago” bilan “I’ve started” demaymiz. Lekin bitta ma’noni ikki yo‘l bilan aytish mumkin: “I started three years ago” va “I’ve been learning for three years”.
scenes.say_uz: Uch yil oldin boshlaganman. Uch yildan beri o‘rganyapman. Ago past simple bilan, for va since perfect bilan keladi.

scenes.title: Xatolarni toping
board: 2) When have you bought this car?
3) I was tired because I worked all night.
4) She said me she was ill.
scenes.say: Each sentence has a tense error. Find it, correct it and explain why.
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda xato bor. Uni toping, to‘g‘rilab ayting va nima uchun xato ekanini tushuntiring. To‘rt qadamli usulni qo‘llang. Uy vazifasi ham aynan shunday bo‘ladi. Har bir xatoni to‘rt qadamli usul bilan tekshiring: vaqt, zamon, jarayon yoki natija, ko‘rsatkich. Keyin sababini ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi xatoni toping, to‘g‘rilang va tushuntiring.

scenes.title: Xato tahlili javoblari
board: 1) I've been working here since 2019. (since → perfect)
2) When did you buy this car? (When → past simple)
3) …because I had been working all night. (earlier activity)
4) She told me she was ill. (tell + person)
scenes.say: I've been working here since 2019. When did you buy this car? I was tired because I had been working all night. She told me she was ill.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchida “since” kerak bo‘lgani uchun present perfect continuous. Ikkinchida “When” so‘rog‘i past simple talab qiladi. Uchinchida ishlash charchashdan oldin bo‘lgan, shuning uchun past perfect continuous. To‘rtinchida “said me” emas, “told me”. Tushuntirish ham muhim: siz nafaqat to‘g‘risini, balki sababni ham aytishingiz kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Since bilan perfect. When bilan past simple. Oldingi faoliyat uchun past perfect continuous. Tell dan keyin shaxs keladi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: had, would va ’d
board: has been /həz bɪn/, have been /əv bɪn/

examples.t: I'd already left.
I'd like a coffee.

scenes.say: In speech, had and would both become 'd. I'd already left means I had left. I'd like a coffee means I would like. The next word tells you which one.
scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda “had” ham, “would” ham “’d” bo‘lib qisqaradi, ya’ni “I’d”. Qaysi biri ekanini keyingi so‘z aytib beradi. “I’d already left” — bu “had”, chunki keyin uchinchi shakl, “left”, keladi. “I’d like” — bu “would”, chunki keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli keladi. Yana “have been” tez aytilganda “əv bin” kabi eshitiladi. Tinglaganda buni payqash zamonni to‘g‘ri tushunishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Had ham, would ham ’d bo‘lib qisqaradi. I’d already left — had. I’d like a coffee — would.

scenes.title: Had yoki would
scenes.say: Is each 'd had or would? Say the full form.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda ’d ni eshiting va uni to‘liq shaklga aylantirib ayting: “had” yoki “would”. Keyingi so‘zga qarang: uchinchi shakl yoki asosiy fe’l. Dastlab keyingi so‘zga qarang: uchinchi shakl bo‘lsa had, asosiy shakl bo‘lsa would. Buni nutqda tez ilg‘ash mashq talab qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir ’d had yoki would ekanini ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: I had seen the film. I would love to come. She said she had finished.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchida “seen” uchinchi shakl, demak “had”. Ikkinchida “love” asosiy shakl, demak “would”. Uchinchida “finished” o‘tgan zamon shakli va ko‘chirma gap, demak “had”. Bu oddiy qoida o‘tgan zamonni tinglashda ko‘p xatoning oldini oladi. Eshitganda ham xuddi shunday: ’d dan keyin qanday shakl kelayotganiga e’tibor bering, shunda ma’no aniq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men filmni ko‘rgan edim. Men kelishni xohlardim. U tugatganini aytdi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa
board: Tell a 60-second story: 'A day that went wrong'
Use: past simple, past continuous, past perfect
scenes.say: Now tell a short story called a day that went wrong. Use at least three different past tenses and one reported sentence.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa: “yomon o‘tgan kun” haqida qisqa hikoya. Hikoyada kamida uch xil o‘tgan zamon bo‘lsin: voqealar uchun past simple, fon uchun past continuous, oldin bo‘lgan voqea uchun past perfect. Yana bitta ko‘chirma gap qo‘shing: “He said that…”. Hozir bir necha soniya o‘ylab oling, keyin gapiramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: yomon o‘tgan kun haqida hikoya qiling. Kamida uch xil o‘tgan zamon va bitta ko‘chirma gap ishlating.

scenes.title: Hikoyangizni aytib bering
scenes.say: Tell your story now. Speak for twenty seconds.
scenes.say_native: Yigirma soniya gapiring. Fondan boshlang, keyin voqeani aytib, oxirida oldingi sababni qo‘shing. To‘xtab qolsangiz, “let me think” deb davom eting. Mukammallik shart emas. Maqsad voqeani zamonlar bilan bog‘lab, to‘xtamasdan aytishdir. Xato qilsangiz, to‘g‘rilab davom eting.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyangizni hozir aytib bering. Yigirma soniya gapiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy hikoya
board: I was cycling to work when the chain broke.
I had forgotten to service the bike.
My boss said I could work from home.
scenes.say: I was cycling to work when my chain broke. I had forgotten to service the bike. When I called my boss, he said I could work from home.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: “I was cycling to work when my chain broke.” Bu fon va voqea. “I had forgotten to service the bike.” Bu oldingi sabab. “When I called my boss, he said I could work from home.” Bu ko‘chirma gap, zamon “can” dan “could” ga siljigan. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi, to‘rt qatlam ishlagan.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga velosipedda ketayotganimda zanjir uzildi. Velosipedni tekshirishni unutgan edim. Boshlig‘im uydan ishlashim mumkinligini aytdi.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Past simple vs present perfect: finished vs connected time
scenes.say: Let us recap. Use continuous for activity and duration, simple for results. Past perfect marks the earlier past. Reported speech moves back one step.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Davomiylik va faoliyat uchun continuous, natija va miqdor uchun simple. Past perfect ikkita o‘tgan voqeadan oldingisini ko‘rsatadi. Tugagan vaqt bilan past simple, hozirga bog‘liq vaqt bilan present perfect. Ko‘chirma gapda fe’l bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi. Xatoni topganda to‘rt qadamli usulni qo‘llang va sababini tushuntiring.
scenes.say_uz: Davomiylik uchun continuous, natija uchun simple. Past perfect oldingi voqeani bildiradi. Ko‘chirma gapda fe’l bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: correct 10 sentences with tense errors
Write the correct sentence + the reason
scenes.say: Homework: correct ten sentences with tense errors and explain each correction in one sentence.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz yoki o‘qituvchingiz yozgan o‘nta gapdagi zamon xatolarini toping, to‘g‘rilang va har bir to‘g‘rilashni bitta gap bilan tushuntiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘n gapning kamida to‘qqiztasi to‘g‘ri tuzatilgan va har birida sabab yozilgan bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda o‘zingiz haqingizda ravon gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: zamon xatolari bor o‘nta gapni to‘g‘rilang va har bir to‘g‘rilashni tushuntiring.

homework_uz: O‘nta gapdagi zamon xatolarini toping, to‘g‘rilang va har bir to‘g‘rilashni bitta gap bilan tushuntiring (to‘rt qadamli usuldan foydalaning). Kamida to‘qqiztasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin.

options: I waited here since an hour.
I wait here for an hour.
I'm waiting here since an hour.
I've been waiting here for an hour.
quiz.why_uz: Davomiylik va for bilan present perfect continuous ishlatiladi.
Son aytilsa, natija muhim: present perfect simple.

options: I've been knowing him for years.

quiz.q: When we got to the cinema, the film ___.
quiz.why_uz: Film biz kelishimizdan oldin boshlangan: past perfect.

options: I have been seeing him yesterday.

quiz.why_uz: When bilan aniq vaqt so'raladi: past simple.

quiz.q: She was exhausted because she ___ all night.
quiz.why_uz: Oldingi davomli faoliyat sababi: past perfect continuous.
Present perfect past perfect ga siljiydi.

options: He told to me he was ill.
He said me he was ill.
He told that he was ill.
He told me he was ill.

quiz.why_uz: Keyin uchinchi shakl (left) kelgani uchun 'd = had.
